jobs.title: Project Coordinator - Construction
jobs.description:
**About Us**

We are a small, tight-knit construction company, specializing in glass & glazing for prevailing wage, public works projects across Southern California. Most of our team has been with us for over five years—we value trust, independence, and teamwork. If you thrive in a professional, stable environment where your work is appreciated and your input is valued, we’d love to meet you.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Project Coordinator with a solid grasp of **public works construction** office operations to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in assisting the project team, overseeing administrative functions, and facilitating communication between various stakeholders. This position requires flexibility and the ability to multi-task easily without micromanagement. There is opportunity for growth.

**Responsibilities**

* Monitor and update bid invitations and calendars; assist with bid submissions and proposal documentation
* Support project managers and estimators by preparing closeout documents and maintaining project files
* Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems for all construction documentation
* Use judgment and initiative to resolve minor issues and improve office workflows
* Assist with Procore project updates and internal communications as needed
* Serve as the first point of contact for visitors and incoming calls, directing inquiries to appropriate staff, screening calls
* Manage daily administrative duties including vendor coordination, document filing, file management, check pick ups, and mailing
* Oversee general office operations including office supply inventory and light janitorial duties

**Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook); experience with Procore is highly desirable
* Able to read architectural drawings and material spec
* 2+ years of experience with public works construction projects
* Strong attention to detail and excellent time management skills
* Bachelors degree or equivalent experience
* Able to prioritize and multitask in a deadline-driven environment
* Willingness to learn and take initiative—training will be provided for the right candidate

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you know to read architectural drawings and material specs?

Experience:

* Public Works Construction Admin: 2 years (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Fullerton, CA 92831 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Program Coordinator Social Services
jobs.description:
Meals on Wheels Orange County is the largest nonprofit provider of nutrition and supportive services for at-risk older adults. It is committed to erasing hunger and loneliness for at-risk older adults through nutritious meals, friendly visits and safety checks, and keeping families together through day services. Through its critical services, the organization delivers nearly 2 million meals to 20,000 at-risk older adults each year throughout Central and North Orange County. Meals on Wheels Orange County is a dba of Community SeniorServ, Inc.  
  
***Hours:*** *Mon-Fri, 8:30 am-5:00 pm*

***Level Status:*** *Full time/ with benefits*  
***Location:*** *Anaheim, Ca*

**Hourly Range:** $20.00 - $23.00 per hour (Hourly rate will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and experience)

**JOB SUMMARY:** This position is responsible for promoting, coordinating, managing, and for the day-to-day operations of the CHOICE Restaurant and To-Go Pilot Program, including completing enrollment and service delivery data entry, coordinating with Community Based Organizations (CBOs), promoting program participation, and troubleshooting other program areas as needed.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Program enrollment data entry adds new clients and assigns SeniorDine meal cards, completing client data entry and assessments in dual reporting systems; coordinates completion of annual program reassessments and completes reassessment data entry.
* Arranges delivery of SeniorDine cards to program participants; prints and mails welcome packets for Restaurant participants; prints scanning cards and delivers them to CBOs for To-Go participants.
* Verifies meals scanned in SeniorDine and ServTracker; makes corrections and updates seconds served in both reporting systems as needed before recording all units in WellSky.
* Coordinates directly with CBOs on collection of required documentation, answering compliance questions, providing status updates on meal allocations, and other promotional aspects of the program.
* Visits dine-in restaurants monthly to collect comment cards, nutrition education reporting, and other survey or reporting data; provides additional printed materials needed by restaurants for day-today program functions.
* Works directly with new Restaurants and CBOs to onboard them including providing training on program manual, SeniorDine system, and compliance requirements.
* Attends community events to promote the dine-in Restaurant program and collect interest lists or registration forms.
* Communicates program updates to CBOs and restaurants including updates from Office on Aging, Environmental Health Department, or Meals on Wheels Orange County.
* Supports other Social Services Department programs (Home Delivered Meals, Congregate Meals, In Home Services) and reporting and administrative functions as assigned.
* Attends staff meetings and training sessions as required.
* Performs other duties and assignments related to the CHOICE program, Social Services department, and company special projects as deemed necessary and appropriate.

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Associate Degree or equivalent preferred; comparable work experience in lieu of formal education will be considered.
* Must be able to work well with persons of all ages, especially elderly people.
* Must be familiar and have moderate experience with Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Word, Excel, and SharePoint; experience with client management software ServTracker and data tracking software WellSky or similar systems desirable.
* Be able to read, interpret and implement regulations, policies, and procedures.
* Must be able to maintain complex records and data;
* Valid California Driver's License and auto insurance as required by state, and ability to provide own transportation (vehicle) is required. Must maintain a clean DMV driving record and enroll in MOWOC’s DMV Pull Notice Program.

**PHYSICAL JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to travel frequently between multiple locations.
* Ability to use a computer keyboard, sit in a stationary position for extended periods, and use office equipment such a copy machine, printer, filing cabinets, and telephones.
* Constantly extends body, arms or hands as needed to perform essential duties and responsibilities.
* Occasionally ascends/descends and positions self as needed to complete essential duties and responsibilities.
* Workload requires constantly speaking, communicating, interpreting or exchanging information accurately.
* Constantly perceives objects over moderate or long distances, with or without accommodation.
* Ability to move, transport, and position objects weighing up to 50 pounds.

***Meals on Wheels Orange County is an equal-opportunity employer and encourages applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive work environment.***

jobs.company: Lundquist Institute For Biomedical Innovation At Harbor-ucla
jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  
The Lundquist Institute for Biomedical Innovation at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center is an independent, non-profit biomedical research organization located in Torrance, California. In dozens of laboratories throughout the campus, researchers are working to unravel the mysteries of heart and kidney disease, cardiac complications in newborns, chronic lung disease, skin cancer, sickle cell disease, disorders of the autoimmune system, and much more. Many of these projects are collaborative in nature, involving experts from different areas of specialization. Our discoveries have prevented blindness in newborns, enabled premature infants with fragile lungs to breathe and allowed children with rare, often fatal diseases to grow up healthy and strong.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in administration and/or office management in an academic healthcare setting. Desired experience with ACGME and other accrediting and regulatory bodies that affect resident and fellow education.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with absolute confidentiality.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Excellent organization skills with an ability to multitask and prioritize competing priorities.
* Must be comfortable working independently and in a collaborative team environment consisting of diverse
* populations of staff, faculty, resident/fellows and other administrative personnel.
* Must be able to adapt quickly to changes in work requirements and assignments in a proactive manner
* Strong critical and analytical thinking skills.

**Responsibilities:**

With oversight from the Program Director and Department Administrator, Medical Education, the Program Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day administration of the ACGME residency/fellowship program(s). The Program Coordinator (PC) assists the Graduate Medical Education (GME) office and Program Director (PD) in developing and maintaining the educational quality of the training program and ensuring compliance with ACGME accreditation standards and Institutional requirements. The PC functions as a liaison between the GME office, PD, residents/fellows, medical students, participating sites, and other departments. The PC will continually assess a wide range of programmatic issues including maintaining databases, communicating with faculty and trainees regarding a range of issues, and collaborating with the GME office to plan annual events including recruitment, orientation, graduation, faculty development events, and various program-related events.

Program Accreditation and Compliance

* Develop understanding of ACGME policies and procedures, including familiarity with the Common
* Program Requirements, Specialty-Specific requirements, and Institutional Requirements.
* Maintain all essential documents required for program accreditation and ensuring program faculty possess the appropriate credential indicated by the program’s Review Committee. This includes confirming that
* CVs containing a current list of publications and scholarly activity are logged in ACGME WebADS system as required by ACGME.
* Assist the PD in maintaining the program’s ACGME WebADS system; keep a working copy and make changes on an ongoing basis.
* Manage and coordinate ACGME site visits, including preparation of the site visit documentation. Along with the PD, help prepare program, faculty, and residents/fellows for site visit; arrangement meeting rooms;ensure required documents are available to the site visitor as requested; and serve as key participate in the site visit.
* Prepare Program Letters of Agreement (in coordination with GME office leadership) with participating institutions and training sites. Ensure agreements are revised as needed.
* Under the direction of the PD, preparing the documentation for the Annual Program Evaluation for submission to the Institutional Sponsor as part of the annual Institutional required, as required by ACGME.
* Administer New Innovations Residency Management System for the program(s), including maintaining resident/fellow demographic data; resident/fellow schedules, importing program and rotation goals and objectives; conferences attendance tracking; and ensuring timely completion of duty hour reports.
* Ensure residents/fellows submit case/procedure log data in appropriate systems as required by ACGME Review Committee.
* Distribution of required documents to faculty and resident, including rotation goals and objectives, program manuals, program policies, etc.
* Establish and ensure compliance with program-specific credentialing requirements (e.g., ACLS, PALS, ATLS, etc.)
* Ensure resident/fellow compliance with Institutional credentialing and HR requirements, including medical licensees, DEA licenses, employee health, mandatory education training, and other training as required.
* Complete surveys and ensure information is current in various GME systems.
* Coordinate and staff various committees, including residency management meetings, faculty curriculum. committee meetings, departmental meetings, meetings with PD, and with the resident/fellows, and follow up on action items as required.
* Manage administrative and planning for logistics for meetings and conferences, including monthly lecture series, conferences, grand rounds, journal club, M&M, ACLS courses, and in-service exams
* Compile and submit required data elements to the Specialty Boards and other professional organizations as required.
* Administration of Resident/Fellow Activities In consultation with the PD, develop and maintain resident/fellows schedules, including rotation schedules, call schedules, and clinic schedules; maintain current schedules into New Innovations and update as needed.
* Coordinate information and schedules with other services, sites, and departments, including rotation/call schedules, and evaluations.
* In collaboration with GME office

jobs.title: Regional Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Tranzito**

Tranzito is a mobility operator specializing in micromobility, curbside management, and multimodal infrastructure for cities. We work with government agencies to help manage transportation programs for the public good -- we operate bike parking rooms and smart bike racks, bus stops, and other transit amenities. We partner with cities and transit agencies, like LADOT and LA Metro, to deploy and operate solutions that make citizens’ lives better and offer practical solutions to climate change. We deploy a systems integration strategy to stitch together off-the-shelf industrial components into a unique configuration.

**About the Position**

We are looking for a Regional Program Coordinator to support key Los Angeles programs, specifically the Sidewalk and Transit Amenities Program (STAP), LADOT Integrated Mobility Hubs (IMH) and other initiatives. Working closely with the Regional Program Manager, you will help coordinate the day-to-day execution of a complex, multi-agency pilot that integrates physical infrastructure with digital mobility services. This role is a great fit for someone with a foundation in public sector or infrastructure project coordination who wants to grow into program management.

**Job Overview**

The Regional Program Coordinator will support a diverse set of responsibilities ranging from schedule tracking and documentation to stakeholder coordination and field operations. The role involves a mix of desktop work, time in the field, and client meetings. You will keep regional programs organized and moving, ensuring that physical builds, digital integrations, and operational workflows stay on time and within budget. If you are organized, proactive, and comfortable moving between the office and the field, we encourage you to apply.

**Regional Program Coordinator Responsibilities & Duties**

**Program & Project Management**

* **Support the Project Management Plan:** Support the project’s governance, scope baseline, and delivery framework, ensuring all activities remain consistent with the approved scope, budget, and schedule.
* **Schedule & Risk Management:** Monitor the project schedule for variances, implement corrective actions for delays, and manage the Risk Register to proactively mitigate permitting, technology, or cost risks.
* **Support the Regional Program Manager**: Support the Regional Program Manager with tasks on an as-needed basis.
* **Support Corporatewide Project Management**: Support Tranzito with broad program management of Asana.

**Client & Stakeholder Coordination**

* **Secondary Point of Contact:** Serve as the secondary liaison for Los Angeles-based clients.
* **Attend and Organize Meetings:** Organize, prepare, and conduct minutes for regular and ad-hoc meetings with clients, partners, vendors, and internal.
* **Vendor & Subcontractor Management:** Facilitate coordination among diverse subcontractors (e.g., design, construction, technology) and third-party mobility partners (e.g., Metro Bike Share, TNCs) to ensure seamless service integration.

**Strategic Support**

* **Strategic Initiatives:** Assist the CEO and Regional Program Manager with strategic projects, including drafting RFP responses, creating operations documents, and conducting market research.

**Regional Program Coordinator Qualifications & Skills**

We are seeking candidates with 3–5 years of relevant experience in project coordination, transportation, public sector programs, or infrastructure.

* **Project Coordination:** Experience tracking schedules, deliverables, and documentation for public sector or infrastructure projects.
* **Operational Awareness:** Familiarity with field operations, maintenance workflows, or asset tracking.
* **Tool Proficiency:** Experience with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Forms, Sites), project management and communication tools such as Asana and Slack; experience with asset management software like Sitetracker is a plus.
* **LLM Utilization:** Ability to utilize LLMs (Large Language Models) for productivity and drafting.
* **Communication Skills:** Clear, organized writing and the ability to communicate professionally with agency staff, partners, and field crews.

**Attributes**

* **Critical Thinker:** Very smart and inquisitive with high critical thinking abilities.
* **Self-Motivated:** Driven to work hard independently and produce great quality work.
* **Organized:** Detail-oriented and reliable at keeping many moving pieces tracked and followed up on.
* **Communicator:** Great communication skills, capable of engaging effectively with everyone from executives to maintenance staff.
* **Passionate:** Loves transportation and believes in the greater mission of improving mobility.

**What you can expect working at Tranzito:**

* **Mission-first:** We are a self-funded, mission-driven company with people who want to improve mobility and help public agencies wisely use their investments to improve gridlock, boost equity and the environment.
* **Positive vibes:** We focus on building and maintaining a great work environment where everyone is trusted to work hard and maintain a great attitude, voicing input and opinions is encouraged, professional growth is fostered, and work/life balance is prioritized.
* **A startup culture:** While founded in 2002 and now with over 70 full-time employees, we retain a startup vibe with a thin executive and administrative team. You will wear many hats and be expected to be hands-on.

**Work Location**

This position will be based in Los Angeles. Regular field work will be required.

**Compensation**

* **$85,000 - $100,000 annually**
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with employer match
* Paid time off
* Paid parental leave
* Monthly cell phone reimbursement

*Tranzito does not discriminate based on the following protected categories: race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status, domestic partner stat

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location:** Los Angeles, California
  
  
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
Join us in building a more inclusive world at Braille Institute of America. We are undertaking one of the most transformative initiatives in our history, planning our next century of success in serving the blind and visually impaired communities.
  
Through our 2025-2027 strategic planning process, we identified the next generation opportunities to advance critical initiatives in areas such as customer research; the expansion and transformation of current programs and services; the development of new nationally and internationally accessible programs; the creation of dynamic new strategic partnerships; and the alignment of our mission, strategy, and resources.
  
If you are ready to join a dynamic organization transforming the lives of individuals experiencing vision loss, we want you on our team.
  
  
WHO WE ARE
  
**At Braille Institute, we are driven by a shared purpose:** to serve the blind and low vision community. We come together to make a meaningful difference in the lives of others, finding fulfillment in the impact we create. We believe in fostering a culture that is collaborative, inclusive, and flexible.
  
We understand the importance of work-life balance, valuing both personal and professional fulfillment. Here, you'll find an environment that supports your well-being while providing opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive alongside colleagues who are sighted and visually impaired.
  
Join us in embracing technology and innovation as we shape the future of accessibility and positively transform the lives of those with vision loss.
  
  
JOB DESCRIPTION
  
  
General Expectations
  
  
All employees within Braille Institute are expected to support the organization’s mission, vision and values, work cooperatively with others, contribute to the positive morale of the department/center and be a respected representative of the organization.
  
  
Job Summary
  
  
The Production Coordinator is responsible for the planning, coordination, and live execution of all synchronous virtual learning sessions, events, and programs hosted on the Vision Support America (VSA) website and Braille Institute digital platforms. This role serves as the operational hub between Programs, Marketing, Information Technology, and Customer Service, ensuring that every live session is published accurately, supported technically, and delivered in a manner that reflects the organization’s commitment to accessibility and member experience.
  
  
Beyond live session management, the Production Coordinator plays an active quality-improvement role — analyzing session recordings, survey data, and participant feedback to identify patterns and opportunities for improvement, and providing direct coaching and support to session presenters. The position requires a practitioner who understands both the technical demands of virtual production and the specific needs of the organization’s primary audience: older adults who are new to vision loss.
  
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  
  
Session Scheduling, Confirmation, and Publishing
  

* Coordinate with Marketing and Programs to confirm all online offerings — learning sessions, support groups, events, and special programs — for both Vision Support America and Braille Institute platforms.
* Manage the end-to-end publishing workflow in partnership with IT, ensuring all sessions are accurately listed, linked, and accessible on the VSA website and any associated platforms prior to promotion.
* Maintain and update the master session calendar in Monday.com, ensuring accurate and current information is available to all stakeholders.
* Verify that registration links, Zoom or Teams meeting configurations, confirmation emails, and reminder communications are functioning correctly before each session is promoted.
* Identify and resolve scheduling conflicts, duplicate listings, or technical configuration errors before they reach participants.
* Ensure that all published session information — titles, descriptions, dates, times, access links, and accessibility accommodations — is accurate and consistent across all channels.

Live Session Production Support
  

* Serve as co-host for live synchronous learning sessions, with primary responsibility for technical setup, link and meeting management, and participant support throughout each session.
* Manage the participant chat during live sessions — responding to questions, escalating issues to the presenter, noting feedback, and maintaining an accessible and welcoming environment in the chat space.
* Provide elevated production support for high-registration and high-visibility sessions, including pre-session technical checks, backup protocol management, and real-time troubleshooting.
* Coordinate audio and video setup, screen-share access, captioning activation, and any assistive technology configurations required for each session.
* Brief presenters prior to each session on platform controls, accessibility features, participant management, and any session-specific logistics.
* Monitor session quality in real time — audio clarity, video stability, caption accuracy, and participant accessibility — and intervene or escalate when issues arise.
* Maintain a post-session incident log documenting any technical issues, participant access barriers, or presenter needs that require follow-up.

Content Review and Quality Identification
  

* Review session recordings to identify audio and video segments that exemplify strong participant engagement, effective presenter technique, or positive member feedback — as well as segments that reflect technical problems, participant confusion, or opportunities for improvement.
* Flag and document specific moments in recordings for use in presenter coaching, quality reporting, or organizational learning.
* Maintain a structured log of identified segments with timestamps, session context, and recommended action or use.

jobs.title: Government Affairs & Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION: is to eliminate health disparities and foster community well-being by providing and promoting the highest quality care in Los Angeles, San Bernardino, and Riverside Counties.

OUR VISION: St. John’s Community Health will be a leader, catalyst, and model for the best care, long-term community health improvements, and sustainable, health-enhancing system and structures in Southern California.

OUR CORE VALUES

Dignity

We honor and respect every person we encounter—whether patient, colleague, or community member—as a valued part of the human family.

Excellence

We support and champion the best standard of care, personal and professional growth, accountability, creativity, teamwork, and a steadfast commitment to quality.

Well-being

We promote and advocate for the full integration of our patients’ physical and mental health in order to enable them to participate in their own health improvement and become active and responsible members of a vibrant and just community.

Social Justice

We collaborate with others to develop systems, organizations, and programs to advance equity and fairness in allocating community resources, and to empower and address the needs of all community members, especially the most vulnerable and disadvantaged members.

JOB SUMMARY

The Government Affairs & Communications Coordinator supports St. John’s Community Health’s government affairs, advocacy, community engagement, and communications work. This position helps turn St. John’s policy and advocacy priorities into clear messages, materials, and public communications. The role also supports elected official engagement, policy research, advocacy campaigns, civic engagement, media work, and special projects. The person in this role should be a strong writer, organized, comfortable working with elected officials and community partners, and able to manage several projects at the same time. The position requires someone who can take initiative while also following St. John’s processes, messaging, approvals, and expectations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Performs a combination, but not necessarily all, of the following duties:

Government Affairs and Policy

* Track local, county, state, and federal policy issues that may affect St. John’s, its patients, and community health centers.
* Research legislation, government actions, funding opportunities, and policy proposals.
* Prepare briefing memos, talking points, background materials, public comments, and meeting materials for the Chief Government Affairs & Community Relations Officer and other St. John’s leaders.
* Support meetings with elected officials, government agencies, and key stakeholders.
* Help track follow-up items, commitments, deadlines, and next steps from government meetings.
* Support advocacy campaigns related to health care access, the safety net, health equity, and the right to health care.

Communications

* Help develop clear messages that explain St. John’s policy, advocacy, and community work.
* Draft newsletters, talking points, stakeholder updates, event materials, social media content, press materials, and other communications.
* Support media outreach, press events, interviews, and public statements.
* Help translate complicated policy issues into language that patients, community members, elected officials, and the public can understand.
* Support communications for major advocacy campaigns, public events, and organizational priorities.

Advocacy and Civic Engagement

* Support patient and community organizing, civic engagement, voter education, advocacy events, and community meetings.
* Help develop materials for advocacy trainings, Right to Health committees, and other civic-engagement efforts.
* Support efforts that move patients and community members from participation into deeper advocacy and leadership.
* Assist with voter education and nonpartisan civic-engagement activities consistent with St. John’s nonprofit status.

Community and Stakeholder Engagement

* Support relationships with community organizations, elected officials, government staff, coalitions, and other partners.
* Help coordinate meetings, events, roundtables, briefings, and community activities.
* Prepare background materials and follow-up communications for external partners.
* Support coalition participation and partnership-building tied to St. John’s policy and community priorities.

Project Coordination

* Manage assigned government affairs and communications projects from start to finish.
* Maintain timelines, work plans, contact lists, briefing materials, and follow-up items.
* Coordinate with departments across St. John’s to collect information and complete materials.
* Support special projects assigned by the Chief Government Affairs & Community Relations Officer.
* Help make sure materials are accurate, approved, and completed on time.

Responsibility to Team – actively support assigned team/department by participating in and supporting all team/departmental initiatives, proactively communicating with supervision, meeting assigned goals and objectives, and committing to embracing process improvement initiatives.

jobs.description:
Job Introduction:

At Sprouts Farmers Market, the Administrative Coordinator is responsible for in-store accounting procedures, cash and funds, timekeeping, and payroll transmissions. The Administrative Coordinator keeps store files up to date and maintains an efficient stock of office supplies. They also partner with Human Resources and Store Management on hiring, onboarding, team building, and conflict resolution.

Overview of Responsibilities:

* Consistently demonstrate a positive attitude, organizational skills, high level of accuracy, attention to detail, time management skills, and willingness to learn new products.
* Take direction, communicate, and collaborate effectively with others.
* Collect, verify, and distribute tills and change drawers.
* Total all checks, cash, credit cards, and create reports from the previous day.
* Oversee the balancing of the safe and create refund reports.
* Prepare bank deposits and record all data for cash, checks, food stamps, WIC instruments, and charge vendor coupons.
* Help maintain front end security to control cash, shrink, and dishonesty.
* Facilitate hiring, onboarding, and training of new employees.
* Process internal transfers and job/pay changes.
* Support a positive and engaging work environment while adhering to all safety, health, and compliance regulations.
* Help plan and execute team building and recognition events.
* Pull and distribute sales reports for each department.
* Stay up to date on company procedures, policies, and benefits to keep store employees informed.
* Keep store files organized and up to date.
* Order office supplies to maintain an efficient stock level.
* Ensure timekeeping and payroll functions are completed correctly and on time.
* Maintain a clean, sanitized, and organized office and work areas.
* Demonstrate product knowledge and provide prompt, friendly service to help customers make their selections.
* Remain informed of sales and ad items to assist customers in a prompt and friendly manner.
* Adhere to all safety, health, and compliance regulations.
* Flexible to perform other related duties as assigned.
* To maximize labor productivity and customer service, the Core Managers assign secondary roles for

  Administrative Coordinators to perform after completing the daily AC tasks. Supporting the Front End as a Cashier to cover breaks and business rushes is one of the secondary roles of the AC and Back-up AC. To provide the most accountable environment, **ACs trained as a Head Cashier may hold red-cards and perform Head Cashier duties.**

Qualifications:

* Must have a High school diploma or equivalent.

* Be proficient in Outlook, Excel, and Word with knowledge of bookkeeping/accounting and human resources software.
* Lift 30 pounds and push/pull less than 5 pounds.
* Occasionally, lifting heavier items during a typical workday is necessary.
* Sit for extended periods and perform repetitive hand, wrist, finger, and eye movement.
* Wear PPE consistent with the task assignment, including but not limited to non-slip, closed-toe shoes, long pants, hair/beard covers, a face-covering or mask, and gloves (latex and or cut-resistant).

Pay Range: The pay range for this position is $19.50 - $29.15 / hour. Sprouts Farmers Market determines pay based on applicable experience and qualifications of the applicant. Benefits:

In addition to a rewarding career, Sprouts offers a comprehensive program to help support you and your family. These programs include:

* Competitive pay
* Sick time plan that you can use to support you or your immediate families health
* Vacation accrual plan
* Opportunities for career growth
* 15% discount for you and one other family member in your household on all purchases made at Sprouts
* Flexible schedules
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* 401(K) Retirement savings plan with a generous company match
* Company paid life insurance

Authentic Brands Group (Authentic) is a global brand and entertainment platform that owns and invests in iconic intellectual property and cultural assets. It accelerates brands through a set of specialized businesses that combine powerful storytelling, premium content, unforgettable live experiences and global commerce. Through a network of more than 1,700 best-in-class licensees and strategic partners across 150 countries and expansive distribution, Authentic's brands drive more than $38 billion in annual systemwide retail sales worldwide.

You'll be able to access the resources and scale, while leveraging innovative technology and nimble environment. What we're saying is, this isn't your average day job. If you're hungry to drive ideas into action and own your career, let's chat. Our team is rapidly innovating to evolve and define the future of our brands. With the help of some of the brightest minds in retail, marketing, licensing, legal and more, we are building the intersection of digital and experiential marketing to help achieve that mission. We reimagine, evolve and transform brands! At Authentic, we foster an inclusive workplace where diversity of thought and expertise drive competitive advantage. Our global teams are built by go-getters who contribute unique perspectives and push the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Headquartered in New York City, Authentic has offices in major metropolitan cities including Los Angeles and Miami, as well as Toronto, Mexico City, London, and Shanghai.

**What You'll Do**

TheManager, Operations will play a key role in planning and executing Dunkman, Shaquille O'Neals professional dunk league and entertainment platform. Dunkman will be this role's primary focus, with responsibility for coordinating event operations, production logistics, and business processes across its programming on a global scale. Sitting on the Authentic Live team and reporting to the VP, Operations the ideal candidate brings hands-on live event experience, strong project management skills, and the ability to coordinate multiple partners in a fast-paced environment. The role may also support the wider Authentic Live portfolio as project needs and capacity allow.

  

**What You'll Be Working On**

*Dunkman Event Production and Execution*

* Support planning and execution across Dunkman competitions, exhibitions, and related activations, from pre-production through on-site delivery and post-event closeout.
* Coordinate with production agencies, venues, broadcast partners, and internal teams on operational requirements, production schedules, rehearsals, load-in, event delivery, and load-out.
* Maintain project plans, workback schedules, operational run-of-show documents, and action trackers; lead status meetings and follow up on deadlines and dependencies.

* Serve as an on-site operational contact, resolve issues within assigned responsibilities, and escalate decisions or risks to leadership.

  

*Business Operations*

* Maintain event budgets and expense trackers, flag changes, and support post-event financial reconciliation.
* Coordinate with Finance and Legal on vendor onboarding, purchase orders, contracts, invoices, and incoming and outgoing payment tracking.
* Document post-event learnings and refine planning templates and standard operating procedures for future Dunkman programming.
* Support planning and execution of other Authentic Live events as assigned, based on Dunkman priorities, scheduling, and available capacity.

  

**Must Haves**

* 3–5 years of experience in live event production or event operations within sports, entertainment, or media.
* Experience coordinating venue logistics, production timelines, vendors, and event budgets; sports competition or broadcast event experience is a plus.
* Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams with strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coordinate internal teams and external partners.
* Sound judgment and the ability to remain composed, solve problems, and meet tight deadlines during live events.
* Willingness to travel and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends as required (up to 40%).

  

**Primary Location Salary Range:** $80,000 - $100,000

We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. The Associate, Account Management supports the day-to-day management of key digital retail accounts, working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, operations, business intelligence, and other teams to drive transactional Film and TV revenue across digital distribution partners.

The Associate will help drive the business across new releases, catalog, pricing, promotions, and merchandising, while building strong partner relationships and providing responsive, detail-oriented account service. * Partner with cross-functional teams to execute business and retailer priorities, ensuring effective coordination and alignment across stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years of relevant experience in media, entertainment, digital commerce, account management, sales, analytics, or a related field.

* Strong analytical and commercial acumen, with the ability to identify key performance drivers, investigate root causes, and translate data into actionable recommendations and business decisions.

**Digital Marketing Strategist**
================================

Location Costa Mesa, California, 92626 Category Corporate JR202639807 Onsite

  

Digital Marketing Strategist  
  

The Digital Marketing Strategist leads and coordinates integrated digital marketing initiatives for Insurance Marketing, supporting performance and brand objectives across Auto, Home, and Life Insurance.

The role is centered on three core pillars: strategic testing, user experience, and advertising operations and technology. This individual connects marketing, creative, media, analytics, technology, and agency partners to move initiatives from strategy through execution.

  
  

The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter who takes ownership, manages projects from beginning to end, and adapts effectively in a rapidly changing environment.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Testing**

* Develop and manage a strategic testing roadmap aligned with marketing and business priorities.
* Identify A/B and multivariate testing opportunities across digital campaigns, audiences, creative, landing pages, and customer journeys.
* Partner with marketing, creative, media, analytics, and technology teams to define test objectives, hypotheses, success metrics, and implementation requirements.
* Coordinate tests from initial concept and setup through launch, analysis, and recommendations.
* Translate test results into actionable insights that inform future campaigns and digital experiences.
* Maintain visibility into testing priorities, results, learnings, and next steps.

**User Experience**

* Evaluate digital customer journeys, landing pages, forms, and online experiences to improve usability, engagement, and conversion.
* Identify customer pain points and opportunities to strengthen the end-to-end digital experience.
* Coordinate web and UX initiatives, including requirements, content updates, testing, quality assurance, and launch readiness.
* Partner with creative, analytics, product, and technology teams to translate business and customer needs into digital solutions.
* Ensure digital experiences align with campaign objectives, brand standards, and measurement requirements.

**Ad Operations & Technology**

* Coordinate paid media execution across search, social, programmatic, display, and video.
* Manage ad operations, including campaign setup, trafficking, tracking, creative delivery, quality assurance, and launch readiness.
* Partner with internal teams and agencies to align audiences, creative, budgets, timelines, landing pages, and measurement.
* Support the implementation and validation of pixels, tags, URLs, and conversion tracking.
* Troubleshoot campaign delivery, tracking, creative, and landing-page issues.
* Support new digital marketing tools, vendors, integrations, pilots, and technology capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign workflows, operational processes, and marketing technology utilization.

**Digital Initiative Leadership**

* Lead cross-functional digital initiatives by defining requirements, establishing ownership, coordinating stakeholders, and resolving roadblocks.
* Manage project plans, workflows, deliverables, dependencies, and status updates in Monday.com.
* Establish repeatable processes and documentation that improve visibility, accountability, and execution.
* Monitor campaign and digital performance and translate results into actionable recommendations.
* Manage multiple priorities while maintaining momentum as business needs evolve.
  

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, digital media, or a related field.
* **3+ years of experience** in digital marketing, strategic testing, UX, web, paid media, ad operations, marketing technology, or campaign management.
* Experience developing or supporting A/B and multivariate testing programs.
* Experience coordinating integrated campaigns and cross-functional projects.
* Working knowledge of digital customer journeys, website optimization, paid media, campaign tracking, and performance measurement.
* Experience with Monday.com or a similar work management platform.
* Strong organizational, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Proactive self-starter with the ability to take ownership and manage projects from concept through completion.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and adjust quickly in a rapidly changing environment.
  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

* A strategic testing roadmap is established and produces actionable learnings.
* Testing insights improve campaigns, customer journeys, and digital experiences.
* UX initiatives reduce friction and improve engagement and conversion.
* Paid media campaigns launch accurately, on time, and with appropriate tracking.
* Monday.com provides a clear, reliable view of project priorities, ownership, timelines, dependencies, and progress.
* Projects have clear ownership and are managed from initial planning through completion.
* Stakeholders have visibility into priorities, timelines, results, and next steps.
* Digital initiatives maintain momentum as priorities and business needs evolve.

We are seeking an Applied Scientist III to own the technical vision and development of an AI-based governance intelligence platform that will redefine how account and organizational governance is defined, validated, and enforced at scale. This mission-critical platform will leverage AI-driven autonomous agents to conduct proactive, intelligent governance operations across the account lifecycle.  
The platform will integrate deeply with organizational management, identity, and cloud-native control systems to provide self-serve, automated governance insights, policy verification, and enforcement mechanisms. The Governance Foundations team is building a unified governance foundation that consolidates account management controls — including automated enrollment, managed policies, and account lifecycle guardrails — into a single, intelligent, scalable system.  
As a senior science leader on the team, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy on ambiguous, open-ended problems that span multiple organizations. You will set the multi-year scientific direction, make the architectural and modeling decisions that others build on, and drive alignment across applied science, engineering, product, and partner teams — up to and including senior leadership. This is an opportunity to shape the future of AI-driven governance assurance at enterprise scale: defining standards, influencing company-wide account governance posture, and leading technical innovation at the highest level.

* Own and define the next-generation governance intelligence and policy-matching platform, setting the multi-year technical strategy for AI-driven governance automation across applied science and engineering teams and resolving the hardest, most ambiguous problems in the space.
* Build on and advance a multi-agent LLM framework for autonomous governance operations, and influence partner organizations to adopt the most promising approaches — including human-in-the-loop enforcement boundaries that cannot be bypassed by autonomous agents.

* Define the scientific metrics, evaluation methodology, and quality bar by which the platform's governance decisions are measured and trusted.

The Accounts Management and Governance team builds the unified governance foundation for account and organizational management at scale. The team consolidates account lifecycle controls, policy propagation, and enforcement guardrails into a single intelligent system, ensuring the experiences Amazon delivers to its customers uphold our highest standards of security, correctness, and operational integrity. jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager (SF/LA/NYC)
jobs.description:
**About Gantri**

Gantri is the product innovation foundry for the design industry. We built the simplest way for designers, brands, and creators to launch category-defining products for their audiences at a fraction of traditional costs. We manufacture products on-demand at our Digital Factory in California from Gantri PlantPolymers, high-performance bio-polymers that replace traditional oil based plastics and eliminate the need for inventory.

Since launching lighting in 2017, we have introduced over 200 products by some of the world's best designers, earning more awards than any other design manufacturer in America, including Fast Company's Most Innovative in Design and TIME's Best Inventions. In 2026 we launched Gantri Wireless, the biggest leap forward in lighting in decades: full-powered light anywhere you go.

**The role**

You will run Gantri's digital marketing engine across every channel: paid social, paid search, email, SMS, affiliate, and on-site conversion. You own the numbers. The single most important output of this role is a cross-channel reporting system built on multi-touch attribution that tells us, with confidence, where each dollar of DTC revenue comes from and where the next dollar should go.

This is a role for a builder of systems, not a firefighter. We are looking for someone who creates order: clean data, documented processes, reliable weekly reporting, and campaign calendars that are planned months ahead rather than days. You will be the person in the room who can say what actually happened, why, and what we should do next, with the model to back it up.

You will manage our two agency relationships (paid media and email) directly and be accountable for their output.

This role reports to our Head of Brand.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build and own cross-channel performance reporting using multi-touch attribution. This includes designing the attribution model, maintaining the data pipeline behind it, reconciling platform-reported and modeled numbers, and producing the weekly and monthly views the leadership team runs the business on.
* Plan, budget, and forecast DTC marketing spend across channels. Set targets for CAC, ROAS, MER, contribution margin, and new-customer revenue, then track performance against them.
* Own the day-to-day relationship with our paid media agency: briefs, budgets, creative requests, testing roadmaps, and performance reviews. Hold them to targets.
* Own the relationship with our email and SMS agency: campaign calendar, flows, segmentation strategy, list growth, and deliverability. Hold them to targets.
* Run the campaign calendar across all channels, coordinated with product launches, designer collaborations, promotions, and seasonal moments.
* Partner with the creative team to brief and evaluate ad and email creative. You will not design it, but you need to recognize what is on-brand and what is working, and translate performance data into creative direction.
* Run structured testing programs (audiences, creative, offers, landing pages) with clear hypotheses, sample sizes, and readouts.
* Monitor on-site funnel metrics (conversion rate, AOV, checkout drop-off) and work with the ecommerce and product teams on fixes.
* Maintain clean tracking: pixels, UTMs, server-side events, and the integrity of data flowing into the attribution model and analytics stack.

### **Required Experience**

* 5+ years in digital marketing or growth for a DTC brand, with a proven record of growing DTC revenue. You should be able to walk us through the numbers: what you inherited, what you changed, what happened.
* Experience in a design-led brand in home, lifestyle, beauty, fashion, or an adjacent category. You understand how considered-purchase, aesthetics-driven products are sold online.
* Exceptional quantitative skills. You are comfortable building and maintaining attribution models, cohort analyses, LTV/CAC models, and spend forecasts in spreadsheets or BI tools. You understand the limitations of platform-reported attribution and how to triangulate with incrementality testing, MMM, or post-purchase surveys.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of the ecommerce stack: Klaviyo or equivalent, Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, and at least one attribution or analytics platform (Northbeam, Triple Whale, Rockerbox, or similar).
* Highly organized. You run on calendars, trackers, documented processes, and written briefs, and you keep multiple agencies and workstreams moving on schedule without being chased.
* Experience managing external agencies and holding them accountable to performance targets.
* A good eye for brand. You can tell when creative is off-brand and articulate why, and you respect that aesthetics are part of the product. You do not need to be a designer.
* Clear, concise written communication. Your reports and recommendations should be readable by someone who was not in the meeting.

### **Preferred Experience**

* Experience with SQL or a BI tool (Looker, Metabase, Mode) for pulling and modeling data directly.
* Exposure to B2B or trade marketing alongside DTC.
* Experience at a company with on-demand or made-to-order fulfillment, where inventory constraints differ from traditional ecommerce.

### **Why Gantri?**

* Be part of a company reimagining how design meets manufacturing.
* Play a pivotal role in shaping the building blocks of Gantri products.
* Drive innovation on our next-generation digital manufacturing platform.
* Advance sustainable design practices in real-world production.
* Work in a fast-growing, design-driven environment.
* Bring visionary concepts to life at scale.

### **Benefits**

* Competitive salary and equity options
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
* Paid time off and flexible vacation policy
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Professional development opportunities and learning stipend
* Collaborative, creative, and sustainability-focused work environment
* Access to Gantri-designed products and innovation in

The Montague Company is a distinguished family-owned manufacturer with a rich heritage dating back over 150 years. Renowned for its commitment to craftsmanship and quality, the company specializes in producing high-grade commercial cooking equipment that combines timeless design with reliable performance.

Overview  
We are seeking an energetic and detail-oriented Production Coordinator to join our dynamic team. In this pivotal role, you will oversee production scheduling, coordinate supply chain activities, and ensure seamless communication across departments. Your expertise in manufacturing systems and demand planning will drive efficiency, optimize inventory management, and support the delivery of superior products to our customers.

* Use the ERP system to generate, update, and manage manufacturing work orders.
* Coordinate with the Production Forecasting Manager and team leads regarding material shortages, part availability, and schedule impacts.
* Help expedite manufacturing builds to support delivery targets and internal production goals.
* Support daily production operations and reinforce company policies, procedures, quality standards, and work instructions.
* Monitor production processes and recommend practical improvements that may reduce costs, improve productivity, or enhance product quality.
* Provide day-to-day direction and support to production employees while promoting accountability, teamwork, and consistent performance.

* Support safety training and reinforce compliance with company safety programs and initiatives.
* Work with the safety committee and management to maintain effective safety practices.
* Prepare and maintain production status reports, metrics, work-order updates, and order-status records.
* Provide floor leadership coverage and perform production work when operationally necessary.
* Escalate significant safety, quality, staffing, equipment, or scheduling concerns to the Production Supervisor
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

Skills

* High school diploma or equivalent.

* Demonstrated ability to coordinate work, communicate priorities, and support a production team.
* Basic experience using an ERP, manufacturing, inventory, or work-order system.

The Scholarship & Outreach Coordinator is a mission-driven, detail-oriented professional who will lead and manage FIT Precollege's external scholarships, awards, and partnership pipelines. This role will oversee the full lifecycle of scholarships from outreach and application processing to recipient communication and reporting, while building new relationships with high schools, industry sponsors, community groups, and grant-making organizations. With a strong focus on access, equity, and outreach, this person will support the growth of scholarship-based enrollment and cultivate long-term partner networks to ensure diverse participation in FITs Precollege Programs.

**Scholarship & Award Administration**

* Manage all external scholarship programs and awards (e.g., CWC, Decorators Club, SJC, Foundation support), including donor stewardship activities such as coordinating recipient thank-you notes, follow-up communications, and donor recognition events.
* Oversee the application, review, selection, and communication processes for scholarship recipients.
* Track student progress and scholarship compliance by monitoring academic standing, managing award renewals, reviewing appeals, and ensuring FERPA- and privacy-compliant reporting.
* Conduct ongoing research on educational best practices, government regulations, and policy changes related to scholarships and grants to ensure compliance, equity, and alignment with industry standards.
* Monitor and implement updates to scholarship compliance, accessibility, and equity best practices.

**Outreach & Partnership Development**

* Serve as the primary liaison between partner high schools, community organizations, and Precollege administration.
* Maintain a semester-based scholarship and partnership tracker to ensure timely outreach, coordination, and follow-up.
* Conduct outreach to new high schools (local, regional, and international), nonprofits, and educational networks to expand access and visibility.
* Develop and maintain partnerships with local schools and community organizations to enhance recruitment and program awareness.
* Research and apply for small grants or sponsorships that support tuition access and student participation.
* Represent Precollege Programs in presentations, briefings, and partner meetings (virtual or in-person).

**Student & Family Support**

* Develop materials and forms for schools and partners to nominate students and understand scholarship application timelines.
* Develop comprehensive knowledge of Precollege programs to effectively guide students and families in making informed participation decisions.
* Collect, organize, and document student feedback and impact stories for reporting, assessment, and marketing purposes.

**Events & Program Coordination**

* Organize and support virtual and in-person events, including webinars, information sessions, alumni panels, and donor or scholarship recognition events.
* Support communication and scheduling with faculty and instructors to ensure smooth program delivery.
* Support the implementation of safety protocols and emergency procedures during events and program activities involving minors.

**Internal Coordination & Collaboration**

* Organize internal meetings and maintain effective communication channels within the Precollege team to coordinate scholarships, outreach, and related initiatives.

jobs.description:

Authentic Brands Group (Authentic) is a global brand and entertainment platform that owns and invests in iconic intellectual property and cultural assets. Through a network of more than 1,700 best-in-class licensees and strategic partners across 150 countries and expansive distribution, Authentic's brands drive more than $38 billion in annual systemwide retail sales worldwide.

**Why Authentic**

You'll be able to access the resources and scale, while leveraging innovative technology and nimble environment. What we're saying is, this isn't your average day job. If you're hungry to drive ideas into action and own your career, let's chat. Our team is rapidly innovating to evolve and define the future of our brands. With the help of some of the brightest minds in retail, marketing, licensing, legal and more, we are building the intersection of digital and experiential marketing to help achieve that mission. We reimagine, evolve and transform brands! At Authentic, we foster an inclusive workplace where diversity of thought and expertise drive competitive advantage. Our global teams are built by go-getters who contribute unique perspectives and push the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Headquartered in New York City, Authentic has offices in major metropolitan cities including Los Angeles and Miami, as well as Toronto, Mexico City, London, and Shanghai.

**What You'll Do**

TheManager, Operations will play a key role in planning and executing Dunkman, Shaquille O'Neals professional dunk league and entertainment platform. Dunkman will be this role's primary focus, with responsibility for coordinating event operations, production logistics, and business processes across its programming on a global scale. Sitting on the Authentic Live team and reporting to the VP, Operations the ideal candidate brings hands-on live event experience, strong project management skills, and the ability to coordinate multiple partners in a fast-paced environment. The role may also support the wider Authentic Live portfolio as project needs and capacity allow.

  

**What You'll Be Working On**

*Dunkman Event Production and Execution*

* Support planning and execution across Dunkman competitions, exhibitions, and related activations, from pre-production through on-site delivery and post-event closeout.
* Coordinate with production agencies, venues, broadcast partners, and internal teams on operational requirements, production schedules, rehearsals, load-in, event delivery, and load-out.
* Maintain project plans, workback schedules, operational run-of-show documents, and action trackers; lead status meetings and follow up on deadlines and dependencies.
* Support credentialing, access plans, staffing, ticket allocations, and guest logistics in coordination with venue, ticketing, hospitality, and security teams.
* Broadcast Coordination: Coordinate with broadcast partners on programming plans, asset delivery, editorial feedback, production requirements, and broadcast standards.
* Serve as an on-site operational contact, resolve issues within assigned responsibilities, and escalate decisions or risks to leadership.

  

*Business Operations*

* Maintain event budgets and expense trackers, flag changes, and support post-event financial reconciliation.
* Coordinate with Finance and Legal on vendor onboarding, purchase orders, contracts, invoices, and incoming and outgoing payment tracking.
* Document post-event learnings and refine planning templates and standard operating procedures for future Dunkman programming.
* Support planning and execution of other Authentic Live events as assigned, based on Dunkman priorities, scheduling, and available capacity.

  

**Must Haves**

* 3–5 years of experience in live event production or event operations within sports, entertainment, or media.
* Experience coordinating venue logistics, production timelines, vendors, and event budgets; sports competition or broadcast event experience is a plus.
* Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams with strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coordinate internal teams and external partners.
* Sound judgment and the ability to remain composed, solve problems, and meet tight deadlines during live events.
* Willingness to travel and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends as required (up to 40%).

  

**Primary Location Salary Range:** $80,000 - $100,000

**Fraud Alert: Unauthorized Job Offers and Impersonations**

We have been made aware of fraudulent job offers and interview requests being sent by individuals falsely claiming to represent Authentic. These scams are often initiated via email, employment websites and social media, and may include fake interview requests, offer letters or attempts to collect personal and financial information.

* All legitimate Authentic job postings can be found only on our official website (authentic.com) or through our verified LinkedIn page (https://www.linkedin.com/company/weareauthentic).

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Location: Secaucus, NJ

Department: Marketing

Reports To: Marketing Manager

Dotted-Line Coordination: Creative Director of Marketing, Brand Editor, and Social Media Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time, Hourly (Non-Exempt), overtime-eligible

Compensation: $26–$31 per hour

Artistic Tile is looking for a Marketing Coordinator to support our Marketing Department while building real event and design skills along the way. This is a high-growth role: reporting to the Marketing Manager, you'll get exposure to every part of the department — email, website, product literature, social, PR, and events — and the chance to take on more as you show what you can do.

Your core work is events, followed by design. You'll help plan and run the showroom events and trade shows that put our brand in front of customers and dealers, and you'll use tools like Canva and AI-assisted design to produce the collateral, labels, and presentations that support our sales and marketing efforts.

About Artistic Tile

Artistic Tile is a family-owned and operated luxury tile and stone company—design, import, distribution, and retail under one roof. We're leaders in our field because of the value we place on design innovation, quality control, and customer service. You'll join a marketing team known for producing content that sets the standard for the industry. Our reputation is established; your job is to help create the work and the experiences that uphold it.

What You'll Do

* Event Concept & Production: Help plan and execute showroom events and trade shows, coordinating the invitations, signage, and on-site branding (working with the Creative Director and design team on the look) along with venue selection, catering, rentals, and vendor coordination, for both in-person and virtual events.
* On-Site Event Presence: Represent the brand in person at events, making real-time calls on setup, signage placement, and presentation so the space matches the approved brand look and event plan.
* Design & Collateral Production: Using Canva and AI-assisted design tools, design swatch cards, recess tray labels, product literature layouts, internal presentation templates, social graphics, and other brand collateral — owning each piece from first draft through final, print-ready file. You'll work within the brand templates and standards set by the Creative Director of Marketing, and extend them to new needs.
* AI-Assisted Workflow & Accuracy: Use AI tools to speed up layout, reformatting, and first drafts, and review all output for brand fit and for accuracy against product data (SKUs, dimensions, finish names, ratings) before anything is routed for approval or printed.
* Marketing Department Support: Support the full marketing team day to day, helping the Marketing Manager and teammates across email, website, product literature, social, and PR projects; organizing and distributing promotional materials to showrooms, dealers, and partners; and keeping project tasks and timelines current in Basecamp.
* Brand Stewardship: Work with external vendors and agencies to keep design and messaging consistent and high-quality across every channel.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, product development, and design to keep marketing materials aligned, accurate, and on-brand.

What We're Looking For

* At least 1 year of related experience in event coordination, marketing, or design.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, design, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
* Experience or strong interest in event logistics and vendor coordination — venues, catering, rentals — and in the on-site energy of a live event.
* Strong time and project management skills, with a knack for prioritizing and hitting deadlines, especially under the pressure of a live event date.
* Fluency in Canva, including building and maintaining templates and brand kits.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude) in design or content work, and the judgment to review their output critically.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication: you can tailor a message clearly for different audiences.
* Comfort working autonomously: you can self-direct your daily tasks and take ownership of a project from concept to completion.
* A collaborative spirit and openness to feedback.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Willingness to travel occasionally and work some evenings/weekends around event dates (all hours worked are paid, with overtime per company policy and applicable law).

Bonus Points

* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop).
* Experience with NetSuite, CRM software, or Basecamp.
* Basic familiarity with email marketing platforms or website content management.

Why You'll Want This Role

* Events with visible impact: You'll help create the showroom events and trade show experiences that customers, designers, and dealers remember — and see how the brand shows up in person.
* Modern tools: We're building our design workflow around Canva and AI-assisted tools, so you'll grow skills that are in demand.
* A high-growth role: This is a launchpad. Demonstrate your skills and there's a clear path to take on greater creative and strategic responsibility as the department grows.
* Exposure to the whole department: Working under the Marketing Manager, you'll see how email, web, print, PR, and events fit together — a fast way to learn the business and find where you want to specialize.
* A great location: A modern headquarters in Secaucus with an easy commute from Manhattan and throughout North New Jersey.

Pay: $26.00 - $31.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program

jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Manager, Account Management | Community InstitutionsOverview  
Mastercard's Community Institutions team is launching Team Catalyst, an innovative new account management model designed to redefine how we partner with our longer-tail customers.  
  
As customer expectations evolve and operational complexity increases, we are transforming from a traditional one-to-one account management structure to a collaborative, team-based model that enables us to deliver deeper expertise, greater consistency, and broader access to Mastercard's capabilities.  
  
Team Catalyst is an incubation team focused on building the future of customer partnership and engagement.
  
  
We are challenging conventional approaches, creating scalable strategies, leveraging data and automation, and finding new ways to bring the full power of Mastercard to our customers.  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to help design, build, and scale a new model while directly influencing customer growth, experience, and operational excellence across a portfolio of Community Institution customers.  
  
If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy turning ideas into action, and are energized by solving complex problems, we'd love to meet you.  
  
The Role  
As a Manager, Account Management on Team Catalyst, you will help shape and execute the future vision for customer engagement within Mastercard's Community Institutions segment.  
  
You will combine strategic thinking, customer relationship management, business development, and operational excellence to drive measurable outcomes for both customers and Mastercard.  
  
Working within a highly collaborative team environment, you will identify opportunities, build scalable solutions, drive execution, and continuously refine our approach to customer growth.  
  
Key Responsibilities  

* Innovate: Help evolve Mastercard's next-generation account management model for Community Institutions, identifying new ways to scale customer engagement, drive operational efficiency, and enhance the customer experience.
* Strategize: Develop and execute customer engagement strategies that drive growth, improve customer outcomes, and strengthen long-term partnerships.
* Advise: Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leaders by understanding their business objectives, strategic priorities, operating challenges, and market opportunities.
* Champion: Lead strategic initiatives from concept through execution, partnering across Mastercard to design solutions, align stakeholders, and deliver measurable outcomes for customers and the business.
* Collaborate: Partner closely with teams across Product, Services, Technology, Operations, Marketing, and Sales to bring the full breadth of Mastercard capabilities to customers and accelerate adoption of solutions that deliver meaningful business value.
* Negotiate: Own the end-to-end deal lifecycle for customer renewals and growth opportunities, including RFP responses, deal modeling, contract negotiations, and stakeholder alignment.
* Engage: Design and execute scalable customer engagement strategies through 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many programs, including webinars, office hours, customer education forums, thought leadership campaigns, and portfolio-wide communications.

  
All About You  

* Builder who enjoys creating new playbooks, processes, and ways of working.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by solving complex problems.
* Strategic thinker with a proven track record of execution.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Some careers are just jobs. This one is different. At **Georgia HOPE**, the work you do every day creates meaningful change for children, families, and individuals who need it most.

We're a Georgia-based behavioral health provider on a mission to instill hope, empower lives, and strengthen communities. Our team specializes in supporting individuals facing emotional and behavioral challenges—often those who have experienced trauma, instability, or significant life stressors. We deliver services directly in the homes, schools, and communities where our clients live and grow, because real progress happens when care is personalized, strengths-focused, and meets people where they are.

As part of the **Health Connect America** family—a COA-accredited organization serving children, families, and adults across nine states—you'll have the resources, support, and professional development of a larger organization, paired with the close-knit, mission-focused culture that defines our work.

**If you’re looking for a career where your impact is visible, your growth is supported, and your work truly matters, you’ll find it here.**

**Health Connect America Family of Brands**

**If you're someone who thrives in a role that blends direct client impact with operational support and team coordination, this role was built for you.**

As a Program Coordinator at Georgia HOPE, you’ll provide hands-on services to clients while supporting the day-to-day operations that keep programs running effectively and efficiently.

**What You’ll Do**

As a Program Coordinator, you’ll balance direct service delivery with operational and administrative support. Your work will focus on client care, coordination, and ensuring program effectiveness. Day to day, you can expect to:

* Provide direct care services to assigned clients while maintaining accurate, timely documentation in compliance with company, state, and payer requirements
* Support day-to-day program operations, including coordination of admissions, authorizations, billing, payroll, and internal processes
* Communicate regularly with clients, families, referral sources, and staff to ensure effective service delivery and coordination
* Assist with staff support functions including training coordination, mentoring, and participation in hiring and onboarding activities
* Contribute to program performance through involvement in budgeting, financial review, marketing efforts, and regional development initiatives
* Support compliance and quality efforts by participating in audits, reviewing documentation, and ensuring adherence to regulatory and accreditation standards

**What to Expect**

This is a hybrid role that combines direct client interaction with operational and administrative responsibilities. You’ll work closely with the Program Director and broader team to ensure services are delivered effectively while supporting the infrastructure behind the program. Success in this role requires strong organization, adaptability, and the ability to shift between client-facing work and behind-the-scenes coordination. You’ll play a key role in maintaining program quality, supporting team performance, and ensuring clients receive timely, well-coordinated care.

**We welcome candidates who bring a genuine commitment to children and families and meet the following qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in human services discipline, including, but not limited to Social Work, Psychology, Sociology, Counseling, Criminal Justice, etc.

**Be Well with Us**

We know that people who take care of others need to be taken care of too. That's why Health Connect America offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your whole self — professionally and personally:
