jobs.title: Home Care Scheduling & Operations Coordinator Administrative Support.
jobs.description:
**Administrative & Operations Support Coordinator**
===================================================

**Gaddiel Homecare Services, Inc.**  
**Location:** Peachtree Corners, Georgia  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | On-Site  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM  
**Reports To:** Administrative Operations Manager

Compensation: $40,000–$46,000 annually, commensurate with qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

**About Gaddiel Homecare Services**
-----------------------------------

Established in 2014, Gaddiel Homecare Services, Inc. is a growing home care agency dedicated to helping seniors and adults maintain their independence, dignity, and quality of life in the comfort of their homes.

We provide personal care, companionship, respite care, skilled nursing services, and specialized support through Medicaid waiver programs, including CCSP/SOURCE, NOW/COMP, and ICWP.

Our mission is **“Bringing peace of mind, one family at a time.”**

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and proactive **Administrative & Operations Support Coordinator** to support our daily home care operations.

This is a hands-on position that plays a critical role in coordinating caregiver schedules, maintaining continuity of care, communicating with clients and caregivers, and ensuring that operational tasks are completed accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate is someone who anticipates problems, takes initiative, communicates effectively, and follows through without constant supervision.

This position requires strong attention to detail, excellent time management, and the ability to remain calm and solution-oriented in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Caregiver Scheduling and Staffing Coordination**

* Coordinate and maintain daily and weekly caregiver schedules using WellSky Personal Care.
* Monitor scheduled visits to ensure clients receive services as planned.
* Respond promptly to caregiver call-outs, cancellations, and scheduling changes.
* Identify qualified replacement caregivers and coordinate coverage.
* Match caregivers to client needs based on qualifications, availability, location, and compatibility.
* Communicate scheduling changes to caregivers, clients, and authorized family members.
* Monitor upcoming schedules to anticipate staffing gaps before they affect service delivery.
* Escalate unresolved staffing challenges to the Administrative Operations Manager.

### **Client Services and Communication**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for routine scheduling and service-related inquiries.
* Maintain professional and compassionate communication with clients, families, and caregivers.
* Coordinate new client service starts following completion of required assessments and approvals.
* Follow up with clients regarding caregiver assignments, service changes, and scheduling concerns.
* Document client communications and service-related issues accurately.
* Escalate clinical concerns to the nursing team and significant operational concerns to management.
* Help maintain strong client relationships through timely communication and reliable follow-through.

### **Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) and Documentation**

* Monitor caregiver clock-ins, clock-outs, and visit documentation in WellSky.
* Identify missed visits, incomplete documentation, and EVV discrepancies.
* Follow up with caregivers to obtain accurate information and supporting documentation.
* Prepare EVV exception reports for management review.
* Assist with reconciling scheduled, completed, and documented service hours.
* Ensure documentation is completed within established agency timelines.
* Support accurate payroll and billing preparation by identifying and reporting discrepancies.

### **Operational and Administrative Support**

* Assist with client onboarding and coordination of service initiation.
* Maintain accurate schedules, operational logs, and service coordination records.
* Monitor pending tasks, deadlines, and follow-up requirements.
* Collaborate with the Administrative Assistant on documentation and recordkeeping.
* Work closely with the Recruiter to communicate staffing shortages and anticipated caregiver needs.
* Assist the Administrative Operations Manager with implementation of operational procedures.
* Prepare daily staffing updates and operational reports.

### **Quality Assurance and Compliance**

* Follow agency policies, confidentiality requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Help ensure caregivers are assigned only to services for which they are qualified and cleared.
* Identify potential service delivery or documentation concerns and report them promptly.
* Assist with administrative preparation for audits and quality assurance reviews.
* Participate in process improvement initiatives to strengthen scheduling accuracy, communication, and service reliability.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Previous experience in home care scheduling, healthcare coordination, staffing, or a related administrative role.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and resolve scheduling challenges under pressure.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.
* Proficiency with computers, Microsoft Office, and electronic scheduling systems.
* Ability to handle confidential client and employee information professionally.
* Strong customer service skills and a commitment to reliable service delivery.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* At least two years of experience in home care scheduling or healthcare operations.
* Experience using WellSky Personal Care or a similar home care management platform.
* Familiarity with Electronic Visit Verification (EVV).
* Knowledge of Georgia home care services and Medicaid waiver programs

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Brayden, Founder at Sola, and I'll be leading the hiring for this role.

Sola owns every layer of insurance, from pricing with weather data to paying claims, and thousands of independent agents now trust us to protect their clients' homes. Almost all of those agencies found us through word of mouth, and as we grow beyond wind and hail into broader home coverage, the agencies that already sell Sola are the heart of our business. We're looking for an Account Manager who will treat a book of those agencies as their own, help them win more with Sola every month, and show our newer teammates what great partnership looks like.

I look forward to meeting you,

Brayden

**TL;DR**
---------

* **Role:** Account Manager
* **Level:** Mid-level individual contributor, one step above Associate Account Manager
* **Key focus:** Owning and growing a book of independent agency partners
* **Location:** West Midtown, Atlanta, GA

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring an Account Manager to own a book of active independent agency partners and grow what they write with Sola. The job is to become the person each of your agencies calls first, keep Sola part of their everyday sales conversations, and turn quiet agencies into consistent producers.

You are someone who has already owned a set of accounts or partners on your own, who measures your work by retention and growth, and who enjoys being both a trusted advisor and a problem solver. This is not a traditional service desk role where you wait for tickets, and it is not a hunting role focused on signing new agencies, since our Territory Sales Managers bring partners in and you help them thrive.

You should constantly be:

* Checking in with your agencies by phone, video and in person so they feel confident quoting Sola
* Spotting which agencies are slowing down and acting before they go quiet
* Training agents on our product, tools and process so selling Sola feels easy
* Solving escalations quickly with our underwriting, claims and product teams
* Bringing what you hear from agencies back to the team so we keep improving

You'll work closely with the rest of Account Management, our Territory Sales Managers and our product team, and you'll help build the playbook that the next wave of Associate Account Managers learns from.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* A defined book of active independent agencies and their retention with Sola
* Growth in quotes and policies written across your book
* A regular cadence of check-ins, reviews and agency visits
* Agent training on Sola's product, quoting tools and process
* Fast, complete resolution of agency escalations across teams
* Clean CRM records and a clear view of the health of every account
* Agency feedback shared with product and leadership
* Day-to-day coaching for Associate Account Managers who shadow your work

**Who We're Looking For**
-------------------------

### **Must-haves**

* Experience owning a book of accounts or partners yourself in account management, customer success or a partner-facing role, typically two to four years
* Real results in retaining and growing accounts that you can walk us through with numbers
* A steady, self-driven cadence for check-ins, follow-ups and escalations
* Strong CRM habits and the instinct to use data to decide where to spend your time
* Clear, warm communication with business owners on the phone, in writing and in person
* Curiosity, coachability and low ego, with a habit of asking why
* Based in Atlanta or open to relocating, and someone who enjoys building alongside the team in person. We work together from our West Midtown office five days a week because we've found that our best ideas, fastest problem solving and closest working relationships come from being in the same room.

### **Strong plus**

* Experience working with independent insurance agents, brokers or another reseller channel
* Time at an early-stage startup where you helped build the process
* Experience training customers or coaching junior teammates
* Comfort using dashboards, simple analysis or AI tools to manage a book

### **Not a fit**

* You prefer a support role where someone else owns the relationship and the growth goal
* You want a pure new business hunting role
* You need a fully built playbook before you can perform
* You are looking for a remote or hybrid schedule

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* Stock options, so you share in what you help build
* 100% paid medical, dental & vision insurance for you and your family
* Unlimited PTO
* Daily lunches and snacks in the office
* Regular team dinners, happy hours and other evenings out, because we genuinely enjoy spending time together beyond the workday

**Our Values**
--------------

* **We are a team of owners.** Every role at Sola has a direct and measurable impact on the success of the company.
* **The best idea always wins.** We leave egos at the door, no matter the title.
* **Always raise the bar.** Our goal: improve at least 1% every day.
* **Customer and partner driven.** Our north star is delivering the best experience to the people we serve.
* **Results focused.** We're a hands-on, results-oriented team with a bias for action.
* **Ask why, stay curious.** Curiosity drives progress. We question the status quo and learn every day.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Sola Technologies Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

Production Artist & Print Project Coordinator

Riverside Graphics and Lowitz + Sons are established Chicago printing companies providing digital printing, commercial printing, design, and print production management services. We handle everything from everyday business printing to more complex publications, marketing materials, and specialty print projects.

We're looking for an organized, detail-oriented person with practical layout, typesetting, and prepress skills to support our customer service and production teams.

**About the Position**

This is a hands-on position combining basic layout and typesetting, preflight and file preparation, order processing, and print project coordination.

Initially, the role will primarily support our existing customer service representatives and project managers behind the scenes, helping prepare files, process orders, develop estimates, and coordinate production. As you become familiar with our customers and processes, the goal is to take on greater responsibility for managing projects and providing direct customer support.

We're looking for someone who understands how printing works, enjoys solving problems, and is comfortable handling a variety of responsibilities in a small business environment.

Responsibilities

**Graphics & Prepress**

* Prepare, review, and modify customer artwork for print production.
* Create and revise layouts for brochures, booklets, business cards, presentations, and other printed materials.
* Preflight files, identify potential printing issues, and make necessary corrections.
* Prepare print-ready PDFs, proofs, and production files for digital and commercial printing.
* Work with our production team and outside vendors to ensure files are prepared correctly.

**Order Processing & Project Coordination**

* Assist customer service representatives and project managers with preparing estimates, writing orders, and coordinating jobs.
* Review project specifications and identify missing information or potential production issues.
* Request pricing and coordinate production details with outside printing and finishing vendors.
* Track job progress, follow up on outstanding items, and help keep projects moving through production.
* Support both Riverside Graphics' in-house printing operations and Lowitz + Sons' commercial print projects.
* Develop the ability to communicate directly with customers and fully manage assigned projects.

**Production Support**

* When needed, assist the production team with basic hand assembly, finishing, packaging, and shipping.

**Qualifications**

* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat.
* Experience preparing artwork and files for commercial printing.
* Working knowledge of bleeds, trim sizes, resolution, color modes, and other print production requirements.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities.
* Comfortable working independently, recognizing problems, and asking questions when needed.
* Good communication skills and a willingness to work collaboratively with customer service, production staff, and outside vendors.

**Preferred, but not required:**

* Previous experience working for a commercial printer, quick-print shop, or print production company.
* Experience with print estimating, job tickets, or print management software.
* Familiarity with digital printing equipment and basic bindery operations.
* Experience communicating with customers or coordinating print projects.

**What We're Looking For**

The right candidate is someone who combines practical design and technical production skills with good organization and follow-through.

We value accuracy, reliability, flexibility, and a willingness to learn. You should enjoy working on a variety of projects and be comfortable in an environment where priorities can change throughout the day.

This is a good opportunity for someone with graphic design or prepress experience who wants to expand into print production coordination and project management.

Pay: $24.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

The Clinical Research Coordinator position is responsible for supporting clinical research staff and managing new and ongoing clinical research activities. Preparation of all study documentation such as protocols, amendments, case report forms, SAE reports, and study reports is an integral part of this job. The Clinical Research Coordinator will adhere to GCP, ICH, and FDA guidelines in the conduct of all study-related activities.

* Communicate clinical trial status to management and staff through meetings and tracking system; maintain related records
* Create and update paper and electronic study patient records
* Participate in other recruitment/retention activities as needed, including calling potential participants and occasional outreach

* A.A. or A.S. & 5 years+ clinical research experience

* Working knowledge of general medical terminology

**Build a Career Helping Local Businesses**

**Universal Energy Solutions** is hiring full-time **Account Managers** to join our **Schaumburg** team, serving businesses throughout the local area.

In this role, you’ll work directly with business owners to review their electricity and natural gas supply plans, introduce competitive supplier options, and recommend solutions that fit their business needs. You’ll primarily manage existing customer relationships while continuing to grow your portfolio through new business development.

Unlike many sales positions where every month starts at zero, you’ll build a book of business that can continue generating recurring income through customer renewals and long-term relationships, all while helping business owners reduce their overall energy costs.

**Why This Opportunity Is Different**

Many sales jobs focus only on closing the next deal. Here, you’ll build lasting relationships with local business owners while creating a customer portfolio that can continue producing income through future renewals and residual commissions.

Many of our **Account Managers** have been with us for 10+ years because they’ve built a "businesses within the business" — creating recurring income from customer relationships they’ve nurtured over time.

We also believe the best leaders are developed from within. As we continue expanding into more than 20+ markets over the next few years, we’re creating new leadership opportunities for Account Managers who want to grow with us long term.

**What You’ll Do**

Your day begins at the office, where you’ll connect with your team, prepare for the day ahead, and follow up with existing customer accounts before heading into your assigned territory. From there, you’ll determine the best way to optimize your day as you crush your goals. Typical responsibilities included:

* Build lasting relationships with existing commercial customers.

* Support customers through future renewals and ongoing energy needs.
* Prospect for new clients by meeting face-to-face with local business owners and decision-makers.
* Review current electricity and natural gas supply plans.
* Help businesses identify opportunities to reduce their energy costs.
* Recommend energy supplier options based on each customer’s needs.
* Develop new business opportunities between customer appointments.
* Build and grow your own portfolio of commercial accounts.
* Travel throughout an assigned territory (typically within a 30-mile radius of the office).

**Is This a Good Fit for You?**

Successful Account Managers come from a variety of backgrounds, but they all enjoy working with people, building relationships, and helping customers find solutions. If you’re someone with a strong work ethic, a positive attitude, and the drive to continually improve, we’ll provide the training and support to help you succeed.

**You bring the work ethic. We’ll provide the training.**

**Compensation**

**Performance-Based Earnings + Residual Income**

* Commission earned on new accounts
* Residual commissions on existing accounts you continue to manage
* Increased earning potential as you build and grow your client portfolio

**Typical first-year on-target earnings (OTE) range from $65,000–$90,000, with top performers earning $125,000+ by consistently exceeding performance goals and growing their book of business.**

* *Additional compensation structures may be available for qualified applicants.*

**Paid Training & Career Development**

Your previous experience gives you a foundation—we’ll help you build on it. You’ll receive **paid, hands-on training** focused on our industry, products, client management process, and approach to growing a book of business.

As you progress, you’ll have access to continued **coaching, mentorship, and professional development** designed to strengthen your skills and prepare you for future opportunities in leadership and business management. Our long-term growth depends on developing talented people who are ready to take on more.

**About Universal Energy Solutions**

Universal Energy Solutions helps businesses reduce their energy costs by connecting them with competitive electricity and natural gas supplier programs. **UES Careers** is the recruiting arm of Universal Energy Solutions, supporting hiring across our growing nationwide network of independently owned and operated offices.

 **Requirements**

**Required**

* Minimum of 2 years of related sales experience
* Valid driver’s license
* Reliable personal vehicle
* Authorized to work in the United States
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Comfortable meeting with business owners face-to-face

**Preferred**

* Previous experience in sales, customer service, retail, hospitality, or another customer-facing role
* Self-motivated with strong communication and organizational skills
* Prior knowledge and experience in the deregulated energy field

* Paid training
* Commission paid weekly
* Additional performance-based incentives and bonuses

* Hands-on training from experienced mentors

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. At every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. One in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. Where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. We show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves.

As a **Strategic Customer Success Manager (SCSM)** in AppFolio's Revenue Organization, you'll own the success of a portfolio of our largest, most valuable accounts. You'll be the trusted advisor to sophisticated operators. You'll build relationships at every level, from owners and VPs to day-to-day teams. You'll use your industry knowledge to help customers get measurable results from the AppFolio Real Estate Performance Management (RPM) platform.

You'll bring the right resources in at the right moment in the customer journey so customers reach their evolving business goals. You'll partner closely with a Technical Account Manager (TAM) and the rest of your account pod to design solutions around each customer's challenges.

**Your Impact**
---------------

### **Retention and risk mitigation**

* Protect and grow long-term revenue by positioning AppFolio as a strategic partner and showing continuous, measurable platform ROI.
* Spot churn signals early through health-score monitoring, then run data-driven plans to protect at-risk revenue.
* Forecast renewals and analyze past churn to sharpen your account-health strategy.

### **Adoption and usage**

* Educate customers on underused features and best practices that fit their business model.
* Use platform usage data to find gaps and deliver targeted training to key stakeholders.
* Map platform capabilities to customer workflows so they get full value against their goals.

### **Growth and expansion**

* Identify and qualify expansion opportunities, including add-on products and service-tier upgrades.
* Pass insights and qualified leads from your customer relationships to Sales and Growth teams.
* Map white space within existing accounts to uncover new revenue potential.

### **Stakeholder relationships and success planning**

* Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers (VPs, Directors, Owners) across your portfolio.
* Translate customer business goals into technology-driven strategies on the AppFolio platform.
* Create and own Joint Success Plans that tie AppFolio adoption to goals like increasing NOI or reducing operational overhead.
* Lead Business Reviews (QBRs/EBRs) focused on ROI, value realized, and progress toward goals.
* Support executive-alignment efforts on your most strategic accounts with senior CSMs and leadership.

### **Renewal and lifecycle management**

* Recommend subscription tiers (Core, Plus, Max) that match each customer's unit-growth path.
* Manage renewal timing and lifecycle milestones across your portfolio.
* Find and nurture reference customers for testimonials and case studies, working with Marketing and Sales.

### **Cross-functional collaboration**

* Partner with TAMs to design and implement solutions for specific client challenges.
* Advocate for customers by relaying product feedback to the right teams and helping shape roadmap priorities.
* Work with your account pod (GAEs, TAMs, Product Managers) to coordinate delivery and value.
* Stay current on industry trends and the AppFolio platform, and add to the team's knowledge base.

**How We Define Success**
-------------------------

* Strong gross and net revenue retention across your Strategic portfolio
* Completed Business Reviews and active relationships with key stakeholders
* Portfolio expansion through tier upgrades, V+ services, and cross-sell leads
* Early risk identification and measurable gains in platform adoption
* Growing customer advocacy by building engaged reference customers who contribute to testimonials, case studies, and other advocacy activities

**What You Bring**
------------------

* **Leadership:** Strong business acumen and credibility as an industry expert and trusted advisor to executives. You lead and work well with cross-functional teams.
* **Influence:** You persuade and negotiate at every level to reach win-win outcomes, and you build consensus across different perspectives.
* **Analytical rigor:** You use data to make decisions and build buy-in. You can size up a situation, define objectives, and recommend a plan.

jobs.title: Bilingual Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Bilingual Marketing Specialist**

Continental Sales Lots 4 Less • Chicago, Illinois • Full-time

**About Us**
============

Continental Sales Lots 4 Less is a family-owned closeout retailer serving Chicagoland since 1965. We are known for great deals, the excitement of the treasure hunt, and creating a joyful experience for our customers, team members, vendors and community.

**Be the Face of Continental Sales Lots 4 Less!**
=================================================

¿Te encanta conectar con la gente, crear contenido y encontrar grandes ofertas? Love people, social media, great deals, and the energy of a busy store? Continental Sales Lots 4 Less is a family-owned Chicago close-out retailer proudly serving our community since 1965. We believe shopping should feel like a treasure hunt, and that our customers, team members, and community deserve a fun, welcoming, and joyful experience.

We're looking for a bilingual (English/Spanish) Marketing Specialist who wants to be out front, not behind the scenes. As one of the faces of our brand, you'll help bring our personality to life through social media, video content, community events, and in-store engagement. You'll create connections with both our English- and Spanish-speaking customers while helping keep marketing projects organized and moving forward.

If you're comfortable on camera, love interacting with people, and enjoy turning everyday moments into engaging content, this could be the perfect role for you. This is not a behind-the-scenes-only marketing position; it's an opportunity to represent our brand, share our story, and make a real impact in the communities we serve. ¡Ven y crece con nosotros! (Come grow with us!)

**What You’ll Do**
==================

**Social Media & Brand Ambassador**
-----------------------------------

* Become a recognizable, friendly on-camera face of CS Lots 4 Less on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and other channels.
* Create and capture short-form videos, photos and stories featuring exciting deals, merchandise, customers, team members and store happenings.
* Work with our team and creative partners to plan content, keep posts moving and engage with our community.

**Events & Community - Make Connections**
-----------------------------------------

* Help plan, promote and host fun in-store events and community activities.
* Represent our company at neighborhood events, Chamber gatherings and local business meetings.
* Build relationships with nearby businesses, schools and nonprofits and spot opportunities for partnerships.

**Marketing Coordination - Make It Happen**
-------------------------------------------

* Maintain our marketing calendar, organize assets and follow through on deadlines.
* Help execute customer emails, direct mail, loyalty communications and promotions.
* Coordinate with store teams and outside specialists; assist with approved digital campaign tasks when needed.
* Keep basic records and results organized and use modern tools to work efficiently.

**You’ll Thrive Here If You…**
==============================

* Love meeting people and feel natural, confident and enthusiastic on camera.
* Have hands-on experience creating social media content, especially reels or short videos.
* Are creative and energetic but also highly organized and reliable.
* Take initiative, communicate well and enjoy a fast-paced, ever-changing retail setting.
* Can balance being a public-facing brand ambassador with getting administrative work done.

**Experience & Requirements**
=============================

* Bilingual English/Spanish required.
* 3 years + of relevant full-time marketing, social media, communications, events or community experience preferred.
* Experience in retail, hospitality or a community-facing role is a plus; degree helpful but not required.
* Candidates are encouraged to share examples of social media content, short-form videos, or creative campaigns they've personally helped produce.

**Work Environment & Schedule**

* This is a full-time position with an initial 90-day, on-site onboarding period. After 90 days, the position is eligible for a hybrid schedule of three days on-site and two days remote, based on performance and business needs.
* Flexibility is important, as occasional evenings or weekends may be needed for special events and community activities.

**Why Join Us?**
================

You won’t spend every day behind a desk. You’ll help shape how Chicago experiences Continental Sales Lots 4 Less, sharing exciting finds, connecting with neighbors, creating joyful moments and building a marketing function with support from experienced specialists. If you love people, creativity and making things happen, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager, Thermal Project Management
jobs.description:
Invenergy is North America’s largest privately held developer, owner, and operator of power infrastructure. With 25 years of trusted execution, we deliver reliable, affordable energy through a diverse portfolio that includes natural gas, solar, land-based wind, energy storage, transmission, and domestic manufacturing. Headquartered in Chicago, we develop, own, and operate large scale projects that power communities and support the energy future.

Invenergy follows a hybrid schedule, working in office Monday through Thursday and remotely on Fridays if work permits.

  

This position will be open for application for at least 3 calendar days from the posting date. This position will remain open for application based on business need, which may be before or after the 3-day posting window.

**Job Description**

**Position Overview**

As an Assistant Project Manager, Thermal Project Management, you will support the Project Manager in leading the team assigned to a thermal power plant. You will coordinate efforts across multiple teams inside the organization, from development to the commercial operation date (COD). In this position, you will manage multiple workstreams in collaboration with the Project Manager and collaborate with all resources to support the project execution and construction efforts, while coordinating other technical, economic, and commercial aspects of the project.

Being part of the project team assigned to a thermal project, you will interact with specialists to develop, design, and build combustion projects utilizing gas turbines for simple cycles, combined cycles, and cogeneration facilities, as well as natural gas reciprocating engines.

Technical supervision during project execution, specifically construction and commissioning phases, including travel to the project site, will also be required.

This position will be based in the Invenergy office in Chicago, IL.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate efforts in the project throughout its lifecycle, under close guidance and supervision provided by the Project Manager from development to COD, to deliver the project according to the required scope, meeting budget and schedule.
* Manage workload, assist resources and the different groups assigned to a specific thermal project, promoting seamless coordination across different disciplines.
* Coordinate and manage internal administrative workload in the project, including purchase orders, service orders, MSAs and EPC agreements.
* Understand project interfaces across multiple contractors and work packages and monitor performance, ensuring adherence to project budget and schedule.
* Report project risks, performance, progress and schedule to management.
* Coordinate contractual and administrative work with contractors, consultants and third parties as required.
* Work in collaboration with the thermal engineering team in the preparation of site layouts and optimization of general arrangements for different equipment and project components.
* Prepare reporting for management and customers as required.
* Ensure record keeping for the entire project by adhering to company document management policies.
* Collaborate with the relevant engineering areas to optimize the design, CAPEX, and OPEX of this infrastructure.
* Liaise with the procurement team in the preparation of SOIs, RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, or any other documents.
* Participate in the evaluation of suppliers’ technical and economic proposals.
* Participate in discussions with manufacturers and vendors, as needed, in coordination with the procurement team.
* Assist in the preparation of contracts with OEMs, suppliers, and vendors.
* Assist in the permitting and development efforts, including electrical interconnection.
* Monitor project progress and performance, reporting key indicators to management.
* Coordinate efforts to prepare financial model along with the commercial finance & economics team and support project finance.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, civil, electrical or structural engineering.
* 3+ years of experience in management and construction of large-scale projects.
* Experience in combustion power plants, gas turbines, steam turbines and reciprocating engines is required.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Strong verbal skills are required, including being an effective leader and communicator.
* Ability to travel up to 25% is required, and travel frequency must be adjusted during the project execution phase.
* Eligible to work in the United States without the need for employer visa sponsorship now or in the future.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in mechanical, civil, electrical or structural engineering with relevant experience in the power generation industry.
* Site experience in projects under construction.

* Strong verbal skills are required, including being an effective leader and communicator.

* Experience managing interfaces between contractors and contract negotiation.
